song.title: Because of Your Love
song.lyrics:
[V1] . G/B Csus2 D G As we come into Your presence . G/B Csus2 D G We remember every blessing . G/B Csus2 D G/B Csus2 That You've poured out so freely from above__ . G/B Csus2 D G Lifting gratitude and praises . G/B Csus2 D G For compassion so amazing . G/B Csus2 D G/B Csus2 Lord we've come to give You thanks for all You've done
[C1] . G/B Csus2 D G/B Csus2 D Because of Your love we're forgiven . G/B Csus2 D G/B Csus2 D Because of Your love our hearts are clean_____ . G/B Csus2 D G/B Csus2 D We lift you up with songs of freedom . A Cadd9 D G/B Forever we're changed, because of Your love
